# C — Design tokens, fonts, styling foundation

**Specs:** `design-system-tokens` (all scenarios); `storefront-project-bootstrap` requirement "Malva theme tokens" (the `@theme` part)
**Depends on:** A · **Unblocks:** I (generated by verify-plan) · **Decisions:** D-002, D-053
**Owner prerequisites:** none · **Skill refs:** `commercetools-storefront` (Next.js stack adapter, Tailwind v4 setup). Design source: `design/DESIGN.md` (Tokens, Principles), `design/source/_ds/tokens.css`, `design/source/_ds/_adherence.oxlintrc.json`

## Goal
`app/globals.css` carries every Telecom design token verbatim and maps it into Tailwind v4; Exo, Inter and Roboto are self-hosted through `next/font`; a lint, a parity script and a contrast test make departures from the design fail `npm run verify`.

## Design

### `app/globals.css` structure (C-01, C-02)
Order of the file, top to bottom:
1. `@import 'tailwindcss';`
2. The three `@source inline(...)` safelists for `col-span-1…12` with and without `md:` / `lg:` prefixes (copy from `/nextjs-setup-project` step 2).
3. `@theme static { … }` containing, **verbatim** (same names, same values, same order as `design/source/_ds/tokens.css` `:root`), every custom property of the design file **except** the three font tokens (below) — then the font tokens, then the extensions block.
4. Base rules (below).

Why `@theme static` and not `:root` + `@theme inline`: verified by the planner against Tailwind 4.3.3 — `@theme static` emits **every** variable into `:root, :host` (including `--space-*`, `--tracking-ui`, `--container-width`, which Tailwind does not know) and generates utilities for the known namespaces (`bg-brand-500`, `text-text-muted`, `rounded-pill`, `font-display`, `shadow-md`). Plain `@theme` drops unused variables from the output; `@theme inline { --x: var(--x) }` produces a self-referencing variable. Do not use either.

Do **not** copy the `@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/...")` line of `tokens.css`: fonts are self-hosted (C-03).

Font tokens in `@theme static` (the value starts with the `next/font` variable so the loaded font wins, then the design's own value verbatim):
```css
--font-display: var(--font-exo), "Exo", system-ui, sans-serif;
--font-cta: var(--font-inter), "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
--font-body: var(--font-roboto), "Roboto", system-ui, sans-serif;
```
Extensions block, introduced by exactly this comment line (the parity script splits on it):
```css
/* ==== storefront extensions (not in design/source/_ds/tokens.css) ==== */
--color-danger: #a1262b;                  /* form errors; design gap, DESIGN.md "Gaps found in the prototype" */
--color-overlay: rgb(62 48 25 / 0.5);     /* drawer/modal backdrop = brand-950 at 50% */
--ext-space-12: 12px; --ext-space-14: 14px; --ext-space-28: 28px; --ext-space-32: 32px;
--ext-space-36: 36px; --ext-space-48: 48px; --ext-space-56: 56px; --ext-space-64: 64px;
--ext-text-30: 30px; --ext-text-48: 48px; --ext-text-56: 56px;   /* promo title, page H1, hero H1 */
```
Rules for the extensions block: names never reuse a design token name (`--ext-*` prefix, except `--color-danger` and `--color-overlay`); other workstreams may append here but must add a one-line comment saying why; nothing else in the project declares custom properties outside `app/globals.css` (a `[data-surface]`-style local override is fine).
Planner default (spec open question): the extensions stay storefront-local, not proposed upstream.

Base rules after `@theme static`:
```css
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-md); line-height: 1.5; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
a { color: var(--color-text-link); }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-action); outline-offset: 2px; }
[data-surface='dark'] :focus-visible, [data-surface='dark']:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-brand-500); }
::selection { background: var(--color-brand-300); color: var(--color-text-on-brand); }
:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
```
`[data-surface='dark']` is set by I on the footer and any `brand-950` background (the pink focus ring would not contrast there). Component styling is done with Tailwind utilities on tokens (`bg-brand-500 text-text-on-brand rounded-pill`), not with component CSS files.

### Fonts (`app/fonts.ts`, C-03)
```ts
import { Exo, Inter, Roboto } from 'next/font/google';

export const exo = Exo({ subsets: ['latin'], weight: ['400', '500', '600', '700'], variable: '--font-exo', display: 'swap' });
export const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'], weight: ['400', '500', '700', '800', '900'], variable: '--font-inter', display: 'swap' });
export const roboto = Roboto({ subsets: ['latin'], weight: ['400', '500', '700', '900'], variable: '--font-roboto', display: 'swap' });
export const fontVariables = [exo.variable, inter.variable, roboto.variable].join(' ');
```
Weights are exactly those of the design's import. `next/font/google` downloads at build time (network needed for `npm run build`) and serves from our origin: no runtime Google request, no flash of wrong type (`display: 'swap'` plus size-adjusted fallback that next/font generates). Only these three families may be imported from `next/font/google` anywhere (enforced by `check:tokens`).
Root layout: `<html lang={…} className={fontVariables}>`. **Coordination with D** (D rewrites `app/layout.tsx` to be locale-aware): whichever of C or D lands second keeps the other's change; the final form is `<html lang={locale} className={fontVariables}>` with `import { fontVariables } from './fonts'`.
Vitest: add to `vitest.setup.ts` `vi.mock('next/font/google', () => ({ Exo: () => ({ variable: 'font-exo-var', className: 'font-exo' }), Inter: () => ({ variable: 'font-inter-var', className: 'font-inter' }), Roboto: () => ({ variable: 'font-roboto-var', className: 'font-roboto' }) }))`.

### Token parity check (`scripts/check-tokens.mjs`, C-04)
Exports: `checkTokenParity(designCss: string, themeCss: string): string[]` (pure, problems), `findDesignViolations(dir: string): string[]`, `checkTokens(siteDir: string): string[]` (reads `../design/source/_ds/tokens.css` and `app/globals.css` relative to `siteDir`, combines everything). `.d.mts` file for the types. CLI prints problems and exits 1.
Parity algorithm:
- Parse design custom properties from the `:root { … }` block of `tokens.css`: strip `/* … */` comments, then match `--name: value;` (values may contain commas, parentheses; several declarations may share a line).
- Parse theme properties from the `@theme static { … }` block of `globals.css`; split at the extensions comment line: part 1 = design tokens, part 2 = extensions.
- Normalise values: trim, collapse whitespace, lowercase hex, `, ` → `,`.
- Font tokens `--font-display|cta|body`: the theme value must equal `var(--font-exo|inter|roboto),` + the design value (normalised).
- Problems (exact formats): `token --color-brand-500 is missing from the theme`; `token --color-brand-500 differs: design "#f9c162" vs theme "#f9c163"`; `token --color-brandd-500 is in the design part of the theme but not in tokens.css (rename or move below the extensions line)`; `extension --space-5 reuses a design token name`; `fonts: found fonts.googleapis.com in app/globals.css`.
Design-violation scan (`findDesignViolations`): (a) in `*.css` under `app/` and `components/` other than `app/globals.css` and `components/label/**`: any `#hex` (`/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/`) or `\d+px` → `file:line: raw value`; (b) any `.ts/.tsx` under `app/` and `components/` importing from `next/font/google` a name other than `Exo`, `Inter`, `Roboto` → `fonts: Foo is not a design font`; (c) any source containing `fonts.googleapis.com` or `fonts.gstatic.com`; (d) **brand-surface text rule** — in any string literal/template in `app/**` or `components/**` `.tsx` (except `components/label/**` and tests), a class string containing `text-white` or `text-neutral-0` → `file:line: use text-text-on-pink on pink-700 or darker, text-text-on-brand on brand surfaces, never white`; and a class string containing both `text-text-on-pink` and one of `bg-brand-(50|100|200|300|400|500)` / `bg-surface-brand` / `bg-surface-brand-subtle` → `file:line: text-on-pink on a light brand surface`. This implements the spec scenario "Text on a brand surface".

### Design lint (ESLint, C-05)
Append **one block** at the end of `eslint.config.mjs` (B owns the file; do not reorder or edit other blocks). Rules are the three `no-restricted-syntax` selectors of `design/source/_ds/_adherence.oxlintrc.json`, verbatim selectors and messages, plus the same three regexes on `TemplateElement[value.raw=…]` so class-name template strings are covered:
```js
const DESIGN_SYNTAX = [
  { selector: 'Literal[value=/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\\b/]', message: 'Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().' },
  { selector: 'Literal[value=/\\b\\d+px\\b/]', message: 'Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().' },
  { selector: "Literal[value=/font-family\\s*:\\s*(?!['\\\"]?(?:Exo|Inter|Roboto))/i]", message: 'Font not provided by the design system. Available: Exo, Inter, Roboto.' },
  // + the same three with TemplateElement[value.raw=/…/]
];
// files: ['app/**/*.{ts,tsx}', 'components/**/*.{ts,tsx}']
// ignores: ['**/*.test.*', 'components/label/**', 'app/**/icon.*', 'app/**/opengraph-image.*', 'app/dev/**']
```
In this block the `no-restricted-syntax` list **replaces** the B blocks for these files, so the block must spread B's `NAV_CONTROL_FLOW`, `RAW_CT_FETCH` (and `COMPONENT_API_FETCH` for `components/**`) constants in as well — the constants are in scope in the same file; add `DESIGN_SYNTAX` to those arrays rather than defining a parallel list (re-open the B blocks 1/3/4 and append `...DESIGN_SYNTAX` when the file matches; test proves both the old and the new rules still fire).
Planner default (spec says "warns"): severity is `'error'` so `npm run lint` and `verify` fail. The Broadband Facts label (`components/label/**`) is the only exempt component (D-053). Hash anchors that happen to look like hex (`href="#add"`) are written without a literal: build them with `` `#${id}` ``-style template parts or add `// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax -- anchor, not a colour`. Pixel values never appear in TS/TSX: Tailwind utilities (`p-5`, `gap-3`, `max-w-[var(--container-width)]`, `mt-[var(--ext-space-12)]`) carry them; JS media queries use Tailwind breakpoints or a constant in `lib/config/` (outside the linted folders).

### Token demo page (`app/dev/tokens/page.dev.tsx`, C-06) — development only
File name uses the `.dev.tsx` extension from A's `next.config.ts` (`pageExtensions`): the route `/dev/tokens` exists in `next dev` and is absent from `next build`. It lives outside `[locale]` so it works before D; D's proxy lets `/dev/` through untouched. The page is a static Server Component (English only, no intl), sections with ids:
- `#colors`: one swatch per color token (brand 50–950, pink 50–950, neutral 0–900, semantic, danger) showing the token name and `getComputedStyle` value is read by Claude, not rendered.
- `#type`: a line per `--text-xs…5xl` with `font-display`, one each in `font-cta` (weight 800) and `font-body`; the three families' names as text.
- `#actions`: a primary CTA `<button class="rounded-pill bg-action hover:bg-action-hover text-text-on-pink font-cta font-extrabold px-6 py-3">Choose plan</button>`, a text link, a bullet list with `marker:text-action`.
- `#brand-surfaces`: a `bg-brand-500 text-text-on-brand` bar, a `bg-brand-950 text-text-on-pink` bar with `data-surface="dark"`, a `bg-brand-100` strip with breadcrumb text in `text-brand-900`.
- `#radius-shadow`: tiles for `rounded-sm|md|lg|xl|pill` and `shadow-sm|md|lg`.
- `#danger`: an input with `text-danger` error text.
Planner default (spec open question on contrast): breadcrumbs on `brand-100` use `--color-brand-900` (6.87:1), not `brand-800` (4.33:1, fails AA for normal text); link text `pink-700` passes on white (6.01), `brand-100` (5.18) and `brand-50` (5.60). The scale names (`--space-5` = 16px, `--text-3xl` = 26px) are treated as stable (owner has not disputed them); if the design owner renames tokens, re-sync by replacing `tokens.css` and running `npm run check:tokens`.

### Contrast unit test (C-07)
`app/globals.contrast.test.ts` parses `app/globals.css`, resolves `var()` aliases, and computes WCAG 2 contrast with a small helper in the test file. Asserted: `text-on-brand` on each of `brand-50…500` ≥ 4.5; `text-on-pink` (white) on `pink-700`, `pink-800`, `pink-900`, `pink-950` ≥ 4.5 and on `brand-950` ≥ 4.5; white on `brand-500` < 4.5 (documents why it is forbidden); `text-link` on `surface` and on `brand-100` ≥ 4.5; `text-muted` on `surface` and `surface-subtle` ≥ 4.5; `danger` on `surface` ≥ 4.5; `brand-900` on `brand-100` ≥ 4.5. Expected values (planner computed): 7.82, 6.01, 12.79, 5.18, 7.81, 7.43, 6.87.

### Pitfalls
- Tailwind v4 has no config file; every theme edit happens in `app/globals.css`. A `tailwind.config.*` file fails `check:versions` (A).
- `--color-text` generates the utility `text-text`; `--color-text-muted` → `text-text-muted`; `--color-border` → `border-border`. That naming is intended, do not rename tokens.
- `--text-xs: 12px` redefines Tailwind's `text-xs` font-size only; line-height comes from the base rule or `leading-*`.
- `--shadow-*` and `--radius-*` replace Tailwind's defaults of the same names (`rounded-lg` is 20px here).
- Hex values inside `globals.css` are allowed (it is the token file); anywhere else they are lint and `check:tokens` errors.
- `next/font/google` needs network during `npm run build`; unit tests mock it.
- The label (`components/label/**`, built in M) keeps literal black/white values on purpose (D-053).

## Unit tests (scenario → test)
| Scenario (exact title from the spec) | Capability | Test (file → `it(...)` name) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Token parity | `design-system-tokens` | `scripts/check-tokens.test.ts` → "Token parity: a missing, renamed or changed token is reported by name" |
| Raw value in a component | `design-system-tokens` | `eslint-design.test.ts` → "Raw value in a component: hex, px and a foreign font family are reported; the Broadband Facts label is exempt" |
| Text on a brand surface | `design-system-tokens` | `app/globals.contrast.test.ts` → "Text on a brand surface: text-on-brand passes AA on brand-50 to 500, white does not on brand-500" and `scripts/check-tokens.test.ts` → "Text on a brand surface: text-white and text-on-pink on a light brand background are reported" |
| Actions are pink | `design-system-tokens` | `app/globals.css.test.ts` → "Actions are pink: --color-action is pink-700 and --color-action-hover is pink-800" and `app/dev/tokens/page.dev.test.tsx` → "Actions are pink: the CTA sample uses bg-action, hover:bg-action-hover and rounded-pill" |
| Fonts available without a flash of wrong type | `design-system-tokens` | `app/layout.test.tsx` → "Fonts available without a flash of wrong type: html carries the three next/font variables and no Google Fonts link" and `app/fonts.test.ts` → "Fonts available without a flash of wrong type: Exo, Inter and Roboto load with the design weights" |
